review_notes: I read the whole file. It contains no new definitions, structures or classes. It has only theorems, one alias, and one positivity extension (`evalTsum`). A grep over Mathlib found no other positivity extension for `tsum`, so that extension doesn't compete with anything. The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication and proof shortening, so I did not report overlaps among theorems. Examples are `Multipliable.tprod_le_of_prod_range_le` versus `hasProd_le_of_prod_le`, the `Finite.of_summable_const` and `Set.Finite.of_summable_const` pair, and `hasProd_of_isLUB` versus `hasProd_of_isLUB_of_one_le`. I found no competing concept to consolidate. I did not do an exhaustive search of every other Mathlib file for concept-level duplicates.
